themes.name: 无法确定
themes.problem: To provide a piezoelectric film excelling in both piezoelectric performance and a withstand voltage without requiring an intrinsically-unnecessary film as a piezoelectric element of an orientation control layer or a protective film; or requiring a complicated process.
themes.means: A lower electrode, this piezoelectric film and an upper electrode are sequentially laminated on a substrate. The piezoelectric film has a surface roughness value P-V of not more than 170.0 nm, which is defined by a difference between a maximum height (peak value P) and a minimum height (valley value V) on a film surface, a piezoelectric constant d31 greater than 150 pc/N and a breakdown voltage of 80 V or more, which is defined by an applied voltage that results in a current value of 1 μA or more.
themes.effect: excelling in both piezoelectric performance and a withstand voltage

evidence.quote: To provide a piezoelectric film excelling in both piezoelectric performance and a withstand voltage without: requiring an intrinsically-unnecessary film as a piezoelectric element of an orientation control layer or a protective film; or requiring a complicated process.

The piezoelectric film 30 has a surface roughness value P-V of not more than 170.0 nm, which is defined by a difference between a maximum height (peak value P) and a minimum height (valley value V) on a film surface, a piezoelectric constant d31 greater than 150 pc/N and a breakdown voltage of 80 V or more, which is defined by an applied voltage that results in a current value of 1 μA or more.
The present invention provides a highly stable piezoelectric element operating at high efficiency, and a method for manufacturing such a piezoelectric element.

analysis.heterogeneity: 该聚类包含多种不同类型的压电元件技术，包括用于液体喷射设备的压电薄膜、具有多层结构的压电元件以及超宽频带换能器等。这些技术在结构、制造方法和应用领域上存在显著差异。
analysis.limitations: 由于聚类中包含的技术主题多样且部分专利仅提供标题或摘要信息，难以准确识别统一的技术特征。
